title: polygala cornuta subsp. pollardii
intro: Polygala cornuta subsp. pollardii, commonly known as Mexican crested prickle poppy, is a plant species in the Polygalaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Polygala cornuta subsp. pollardii are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
